subject: Fix GEOSEARCH repeated BYPOLYGON memory leak (#4995)
reason: Pure memory-leak fix: repeated GEOSEARCH/GEOSEARCHSTORE BYPOLYGON now frees the earlier polygon-vertex allocation before re-allocating. Both builds already accept repeated BYPOLYGON and use the last polygon, so all replies, errors, and stored data are identical before and after the fix; the only difference is reclaimed heap. The sole effect is invisible to reply- and state-comparison oracles (the project's own test for it samples used_memory and is external:skip), and no installed or writable experiment can observe heap usage or sanitizer leak reports, so no scenario can reach the changed beha
